goal: Play a full round: put out fires, rescue everyone, refill water
summary: The playtester tried to grab gear from the locker room racks and then used the Mission Board to start a round. Every interact came back 'held, not triggered', so the backpack stayed empty and no round started. No fires were fought, no one was rescued, and water was never refilled. The probe reported no server errors.

bugs.title: Gear rack prompts (Grab Axe / Grab Extinguisher) never trigger when in range
bugs.evidence: Steps 1, 3 and 6 interacted with GearRack1 'Grab Axe' at 7.8 and about 3.4-3.8 studs (range 9, hold 0). Step 5 interacted with GearRack2 'Grab Extinguisher'. Every result was 'held, not triggered'. Carrying stayed "" and the backpack stayed empty, so no gear was granted. This blocks the goal.

bugs.title: Mission Board 'Pick a call' prompt does not trigger, so the round cannot start
bugs.evidence: Step 8 interacted with Workspace.Map.Station.Lobby.MissionBoard with the board in range (MissionBoard@6). The result was 'held, not triggered' for 'Pick a call Mission Board'. The game stayed in the Lobby state, so no fires or rescues were ever set up.

bugs.title: Walk-to-gear-rack movement barely changes position and reports arrival
bugs.evidence: Step 2 reported 'arrived 2.8 studs from target', yet the observed position stayed at about [-51, 3.8, 108]. Step 3 showed [-61.1, 3.6, 109.6]. Step 7 reported arriving at the MissionBoard, but the observed position was still [-61.5, 3.3, 109.6]. The reported position lags behind movement, or the pathing and arrival reporting is unreliable. This may be a tool or observation artifact rather than a game fault.
